title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description: TL;DR You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What we're looking for 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level. Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM. Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse). Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem. Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration. Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs. What you'll do Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks. Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team. Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through. Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection. Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it. Our tech stack Frontend: React and Typescript. Backend: Golang and Rust. Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers. DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform). Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery. And we’re always exploring what’s next! About your application Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. Our Customer Success team is seeking a Customer Onboarding Manager for the UK market. In this role, you’ll be responsible for guiding customers through every step of setting up, integrating and activating our platform. Working with Sales, CSM and Product, you’ll play a key part in increasing customer loyalty and satisfaction, ensuring new customers experience the full value and benefits of our product for their business operations. Your responsibilities Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day: Customer Understanding - Partner with the Sales team to understand the customer needs and objectives. Work closely with customers to clarify requirements and timelines to tailor the onboarding plan. Strategic Onboarding Planning - Develop and continuously refine onboarding strategies and project plans outlining tasks, milestones, and timelines. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful customer activation and satisfaction. Customer Guidance & Education - Serve as a key point of contact for customers throughout the onboarding process, providing expert guidance, support and documentation as needed. Address and resolve any issues or challenges that arise. Conduct training sessions for clients to ensure they are proficient in using the Moss platform. Progress Monitoring & Reporting - Maintain client information up-to-date in CRM (Salesforce). Monitor and report on the progress of the onboarding process, identifying risks and obstacles and developing solutions to overcome them. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams within the company to escalate and resolve technical issues. Drive initiatives for continuous improvement, gathering feedback from customers and sharing it with internal teams to enhance the overall onboarding process. About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in this role: Proven experience in an onboarding, implementation, support, or project management position, involving direct customer engagement with finance professionals. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Complex Problem Solver - You’re able to find solutions to even the most complex problems, breaking them down into manageable components and developing original and effective solutions. You address issues promptly, and adapt strategies in response to changing priorities and needs. Data-driven Strategist - You have a data-driven, structured and solution-oriented way of working, enabling you to juggle multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. You leverage data to prioritize customer portfolios and internal tasks, ensuring the quality and impact of your work. Domain Expert - You have a good understanding of finance and accounting, but you’re always curious and eager to deepen your knowledge of the product and the domain. You proactively seek learning resources, keep up-to-date on industry trends and connect with other experts. As the go-to person on all things onboarding and accounting related, you enjoy discussing product feedback and improvements internally. Customer Focused - You demonstrate empathy and credibility in customer discussions about their needs, making them feel understood and heard. You’re able to adapt your communication to different audiences, from finance leaders to external accountants, allowing you to build trusting customer relationships. Team Player - You contribute to the Moss culture and ways of working by promoting collaboration, learning, and growth across peers and leaders. Ownership - You independently execute end-to-end onboarding projects, from the Sales’ handover to the transition to CSM/CS and beyond. You show persistence, accountability and initiative across every aspect of your work, from achieving customer activation goals by consistently following up on customer communications, to driving your own learning and development. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. title: Head of Compliance Product
description: We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI. Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it. You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it. This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence. What you'll do Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done. Lead product for our agentic compliance programme : AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start. Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect. Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways : Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why. Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with. Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences. What this role is not Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme. Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention. Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems. Who we're looking for 10+ years building software products , including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you. A genuine zero-to-one track record : an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on. Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company. Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus. AI-native : AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role. Deep executional rigour : you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line. High self-sufficiency : you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn. Continuous systems thinking : you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster. A data-informed operating style : you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees. Judgement under ambiguity : you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist. Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments : you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality. Restlessness about velocity and quality : you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested. If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you. title: Bid Manager
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Work with subject matter experts (clinicians, clinical safety officers, engineers, security and finance) to get the right input on time, and turn complex technical and regulatory detail into clear, compliant answers. Develop win themes and executive summaries that connect our evidence to what each buyer is actually scoring. Track upcoming tenders, frameworks and dynamic markets, and help Commercial leadership decide where to spend our effort. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. 4 core values for a good life We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. We enshrined our values in our vision We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _________________________________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You're where every Shape deal starts, and one of the people who sets the standard for how we prospect. As you grow, you'll shape our messaging and set the bar for the SDRs who join after you. What the job actually is You know the job. Most of your day is on the phone, and you'll hear "no", "not now" and "just send me an email" more than anything else. Here, you'll be calling commercial, project and operations leaders at tier 1 and tier 2 construction firms (main contractors and the subcontractors who work for them). They're running live projects, their time is precious and they're wary of anyone selling software. Almost all of our pipeline is outbound, apart from customer referrals, so the meetings you book are ones you've created yourself. You also know that to be good at cold calling, you have to genuinely love it. If you don't, and you plan to go through the motions, it's a boring job, and it shows on every call. We're looking for someone who still gets a buzz from turning a cold "who's this?" into a real conversation. Quality over quantity, always. We care about the work we do and take pride in doing it properly, and we want people who feel the same. You'll know a booked meeting isn't the same as a good one. Here, it means understanding their problem properly: being curious enough to ask the second and third question, listening more than you talk, and knowing by the end of the call what's actually going wrong for them, on which project, and why it matters now. It also means only offering a solution to people who genuinely want or need to fix it. If they don't, you thank them and move on. Get that right and the meeting follows naturally, and it's one worth having. How the team is set up You'll sit in the UK sales team, working day to day with an Account Executive who takes your meetings forward to a free launch and then a contract. You open the door, they win the deal, and you succeed together. You'll work with a CRM, a dialler and call recording, plus a playbook, a library of calls that have actually won, and AI call-prep tools built for how we sell. Where you'll work Remote, anywhere in the UK, with the chance to attend industry events in person in the near future. Why it's worth it A career in a market that's only just going digital: around $10 trillion is spent on construction every year, yet it's one of the least digitised industries in the world, and spending on construction management software is forecast to nearly double by 2030. People who can sell software and genuinely understand construction are rare. Learn both here, and you'll have skills that stay in demand for years as the industry catches up, and you'll be helping it work better along the way. Senior conversations from the start: you'll be speaking directly to leaders at some of the UK's biggest construction firms, not working your way through gatekeepers. Coaching that knows the industry: weekly reviews and coaching from people who've lived and breathed construction, on site, not just on the phones. A playbook that works: built from calls that have won, so you're not starting from scratch. Progression on merit: a proper conversation about your next step within a year, based on what you've shown. You'll shape how we sell: what you learn and suggest makes it into the playbook. A 4-day week: the same standards and targets, delivered in four days. Your top responsibilities Open doors: start proper conversations, every day, with the people who feel the problem and can decide. Qualify properly: test the problem early, dig in before you pitch, and keep qualifying after the "yes". Hand over cleanly: your CRM notes tell the story, so your Account Executive picks up exactly where you left off. Be obsessed with your numbers: know them every day, track them weekly and act on what they tell you. Raise the bar: once you're up to speed, share what's working, contribute to the playbook and help newer SDRs get better faster. Your roadmap: your first 30 days and beyond You bring the experience. We'll make sure you're selling the Shape way, with confidence, by week 3 or 4. Before day 1, ready to go: your CRM, dialler, call recording and your own Shape login set up, so week 1 is spent learning. Week 1, understand the why: the problems we solve, who for, and why it beats how contractors work today, with the product shown in action by Customer Success. title: Product Owner
description: Pet Drugs Online Role IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. Pet Drugs Online is one of the UK’s leading online pet pharmacies and retailers, helping pet owners access trusted medication, healthcare products, and everyday essentials quickly, safely, and conveniently. As part of the IVC Evidensia Group, Pet Drugs Online combines the agility of a growing ecommerce business with the strength and expertise of a leading veterinary care organisation. Our teams play a vital role in making pet healthcare more accessible through innovation, operational excellence, and outstanding customer experience. Help shape the future of eCommerce at Pet Drugs Online. This is an exciting opportunity to join our eCommerce team at a time when there's plenty of opportunity to make a real impact. From improving website functionality and customer journeys to introducing new technologies and enhancing internal processes, there's no shortage of interesting projects to get involved in. Working closely with our Lead Product Owner, you'll play a key role in turning business ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements, bridging the gap between commercial stakeholders and technical delivery teams. The Role This is a varied, hands-on position combining Product Ownership and Business Analysis responsibilities. You'll take ownership of initiatives from initial discovery and requirements gathering through to development, testing and launch. You'll work closely with stakeholders across eCommerce, Marketing, Commercial, Customer Service and Operations, as well as our external development agency and internal technology teams. Some of the key areas you'll be involved in include: Product Development: Help shape and deliver improvements across the Pet Drugs Online website, identifying opportunities to enhance functionality and customer experience. Discovery & Requirements: Work with stakeholders to understand business challenges, explore opportunities and translate ideas into clear, actionable requirements. Backlog Management: Create and maintain product backlogs, write user stories and acceptance criteria, and support prioritisation of development activities. Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships across the business, facilitating discussions, challenging existing processes and ensuring everyone understands the objectives and proposed solutions. Agile Delivery: Work closely with developers, QA and our external development agency, supporting sprint activities, clarifying requirements and resolving queries throughout development. Testing & Launch: Support user acceptance testing, validate delivered functionality and ensure new features and improvements are ready for release. Continuous Improvement: Monitor performance, gather feedback and identify further opportunities to improve both customer-facing experiences and internal business processes. What makes this opportunity interesting? Pet Drugs Online is already a successful eCommerce business, but there is significant opportunity to take its digital offering to the next level. You'll be joining at a particularly interesting time, with several important initiatives and improvements across the website and wider customer journey. Some of the areas you'll have exposure to include: Enhancing the online prescription journey, making it easier and more straightforward for customers to purchase medication for their pets. Improving website search, product discovery and merchandising through new technologies. Developing and improving subscription journeys. Enhancing key website experiences, including the basket, checkout and customer account areas. Exploring new ways to improve customer experience, website functionality and operational efficiency. You'll have the opportunity to work across a broad range of initiatives, from smaller improvements and fixes through to larger, more strategic projects. About You We're looking for someone who understands digital products and eCommerce, enjoys solving problems and can confidently bring different stakeholders together to deliver meaningful improvements. You'll ideally bring: Experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Digital Product or eCommerce role. Experience working on digital or eCommerce platforms, with an understanding of website functionality and customer journeys. A track record of contributing to digital improvements or projects, ideally with examples such as website enhancements, checkout improvements, conversion rate optimisation or platform changes. Experience gathering requirements, documenting processes and translating business needs into user stories and acceptance criteria. An understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and experience working alongside development teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and insight to inform decisions. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences. Just as important is your approach. You'll be a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership, working independently and making recommendations. You'll be confident challenging existing ways of working, facilitating discussions and explaining the reasoning behind your decisions. You don't need to be particularly technical or have experience with a specific platform. What's important is that you understand how digital products are developed and can effectively bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery. title: Director, Venture Cafe London
description: Are you a natural leader with a strong network, driven to tackle your city's biggest challenges and connect diverse groups to make things happen? If so, you belong at Venture Café! The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. This is a unique opportunity to operate and grow a hub for Deeptech innovation and connection, in close collaboration with ARIA . We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone. Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. Featuring vibrant networking sessions activated with captivating demos or immersion in the night’s theme by attending thought-provoking sessions led by inspiring speakers. Here, curiosity meets opportunity, connections flourish, and innovation thrives. Venture Café was founded by Tim Rowe, founder and CEO of the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC), in 2009 and helped fuel the growth of one of the world’s most powerful innovation ecosystems: Boston’s Kendall Square. What began with a modest gathering of 12 people at our inaugural Thursday Gathering has flourished into the Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI). Over the past 15 years, VCGI has united over 900,000 visionaries, developers, creatives, and civic leaders across 24cities worldwide, building a global community of communities. At VCGI, we believe if we’re going to solve humankind’s biggest challenges, we need as many amazing humans as possible involved in that process. Your goal is to ensure Venture Café programming continues to connect local innovators to the national and international entrepreneurship community. Your role would be to execute weekly Venture Café Thursday Gatherings including the following: • Collaborating closely with VCGI and ARIA to continue to successfully implement and refine the strategy for Venture Café London. • Scoping and securing financial partners for Venture Café London and building a pipeline for funding opportunities. • Working closely with the Head of UK and the other UK Directors to ensure success and align initiatives where appropriate. • Scoping and developing a rolling programming strategy to inspire and connect the local innovation community. • Collaborate with the ARIA team and Programme Directors to drive value to the ARIA Opportunity Spaces. • Identifying and partnering with local ecosystem leaders as an advocate and spokesperson to build diverse and inclusive programs. • Developing innovative program formats for delivering content and creating connection opportunities to maximize engagement. • Leading and overseeing strategic planning, impact measurement and program budget for Venture Café in London. • Attracting sponsorship for programs and aligning them within the Thursday Gathering framework. • L eading and coaching your three direct reports towards success. • Continuously reviewing and implementing improvements/changes to ensure the ongoing success and reputation of Venture Café London. • Collaborating with the Venture Café global network and ARIA to connect the London community to global opportunities. • Identifying and mitigating risks to the effective operation of the Thursday Gathering. • Nurturing existing initiatives to support Venture Café’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB) efforts, while bringing a visionary approach to developing and expanding DEIB-driven programming and partnership opportunities. ABOUT YOU You understand your city’s challenges and see them as opportunities, combining a fascination with trends and a humanistic perspective. Passionate about mission-driven work, you'll lead Venture Café London by nurturing relationships, leading teams, and thriving in ambiguity. Your skills include leading programs, matchmaking, innovating, connecting with the community, and fostering collaboration. You are comfortable with public speaking, have excellent communication skills, and excel at connecting across business, academia, government, and civil society. You bring a global outlook with local roots and a strong community commitment. ​​More specifically, you thrive in: • Leading people and complex programs. • Being a match-maker extraordinaire and seeing opportunities at the intersections of people, ideas & resources. • Envisioning, developing and implementing innovative program experiences. • Connecting with a broad cross-section of the community. • Bringing people together to collaborate towards a common goal. • Identifying and developing mutually beneficial partnerships. Additionally, you have: • Knowledge of London’s startup community, key influencers, networks and organizations. • Excellent organizational, project, and task management skills. • Experience securing funding opportunities and a network of potential funders. • Comfort in Google Suite, email campaign software, and project management software. • Fluency in English. • Ability to legally work in the UK. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time. OUR OFFER • Employment contract. • Competitive compensation based on experience • 4% Pension Contribution • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays • Supplemental medical and dental insurance • £200 Monthly Commuter Allowance • Life insurance • Business Travel Insurance • Hybrid work model – You will work three days per week in the office, with Thursdays required as a core in-office day. VENTURE CAFÉ LONDON - GUIDING ORGANIZATIONAL OBJECTIVES As an organization, Venture Café London is guided by five core objectives that shape how success is measured. These objectives are advanced through purposeful programming, storytelling, and bringing together a diverse community of innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, corporates, and ecosystem partners. Broaden access to innovation and economic opportunity. Lower barriers to entry and create an inclusive, welcoming environment where people from diverse backgrounds can participate in and contribute to London's innovation ecosystem. Connect people and break down silos. Build bridges across sectors, disciplines, industries, and communities to encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the development of a globally competitive innovation ecosystem. Improve access to resources and opportunities. Foster meaningful relationships that connect innovators and entrepreneurs with the capital, talent, expertise, ideas, and strategic partnerships they need to develop and scale their ventures. Create spaces for meaningful human connection. Bring people together through accessible, engaging experiences that encourage the exchange of ideas, build trust, and turn spontaneous interactions into lasting relationships and collaborations. Strengthen the wider innovation ecosystem through shared resources. Openly share knowledge, tools, and opportunities while collaborating with ecosystem partners to align efforts, amplify impact, and support collective progress. The Venture Café Gathering The flagship Venture Café model is the weekly Gathering: a recurring community event where innovators, entrepreneurs, investors, researchers, and other ecosystem stakeholders come together to exchange ideas, share knowledge, explore emerging technologies, and build meaningful connections. Through expert-led discussions, educational sessions, networking opportunities, and informal interactions, the Gathering creates the conditions for collaboration and new opportunities to emerge organically. It serves as a platform for connecting London's innovation community and provides a foundation for wider programming, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem-building initiatives. The Gathering is more than an event; it is a recurring platform for strengthening relationships across the innovation ecosystem and helping promising ideas develop into meaningful collaborations and real-world outcomes. title: Engineering Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h2>About Axon</h2> <p>Axon’s mission is bold and simple: Protect Life. We build technology that gives first responders, enterprises and communities the clarity to act in the moments that matter most.</p> <p>Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, powered by Fusus, is transforming how public safety and security organisations detect, assess and respond to incidents. By connecting live video, devices and operational systems, we help customers build a shared understanding of what is happening—and respond with greater confidence.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Director of Software Engineering to help build and scale the mission-critical software behind these experiences.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>As Director of Software Engineering within Real-Time Operations, you will lead multiple engineering teams delivering secure, reliable and scalable software for public safety and enterprise customers.</p> <p>You will own the technical direction and engineering execution for your area, translating product priorities into clear plans and measurable outcomes. Working closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders, you will guide architectural decisions, develop engineering talent and ensure teams deliver software that customers can depend on.</p> <p>This role requires a leader who combines technical depth with strong people leadership. You will be comfortable moving between long-term strategy and delivery detail—challenging assumptions, making trade-offs and creating the conditions for teams to do their best work.</p> <h2>Your Impact</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver technology that matters.</strong> Lead teams building software that supports real-time situational awareness and incident response.</li> <li><strong>Shape technical direction.</strong> Establish a clear technical strategy that balances customer needs, platform reuse and long-term maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Build strong teams.</strong> Develop engineering managers and technical leaders, strengthening ownership, collaboration and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Raise engineering standards.</strong> Improve reliability, security and delivery quality across systems that span devices, cloud services and user-facing applications.</li> <li><strong>Connect strategy to execution.</strong> Partner with Product and Design to turn customer problems into prioritised roadmaps and dependable delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>VP, Software Engineering</p> <p><strong>Work Location:</strong> This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.</p> <p><strong>Role & Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop multiple software engineering teams, setting clear expectations for technical quality, delivery and team performance.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Design to define roadmaps, sequence investments and make informed trade-offs between new capabilities, platform improvements and technical debt.</li> <li>Guide architecture and system-design decisions across your area, engaging directly with engineers on complex technical challenges.</li> <li>Build engineering practices that strengthen testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and deployment confidence.</li> <li>Own the operational health of your services, using incidents and customer feedback to drive lasting improvements.</li> <li>Hire, coach and develop engineering managers, technical leads and engineers; address performance issues with clarity and candour.</li> <li>Collaborate across Axon to deliver integrated experiences and resolve dependencies between teams.</li> <li>Work with Security, Privacy and Compliance partners to embed customer and regulatory requirements into engineering decisions.</li> <li>Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly, creating alignment without adding unnecessary processes.</li> </ul> <h2>What You Bring</h2> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of total experience in software engineering, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles, with experience leading teams and developing engineering leaders.</li> <li>A track record of delivering complex software products through multiple teams, from planning and architecture through launch and operation.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency in distributed systems, cloud services and modern software architecture.</li> <li>Experience building secure, reliable systems where availability, performance and customer trust are critical.</li> <li>Proven ability to balance delivery commitments with the investment needed to improve platform quality and maintainability.</li> <li>Strong judgement in ambiguous environments, with the ability to make decisions, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product, Design and other engineering organisations.</li> <li>A commitment to building inclusive, high-trust teams and developing talent.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Real-time systems, video streaming, IoT or device-to-cloud architectures.</li> <li>Enterprise security, public safety technology or other mission-critical software environments.</li> <li>Platform modernisation, complex integrations or scaling products across international markets.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Mission-driven:</strong> You connect engineering decisions to meaningful outcomes for customers and communities.</li> <li><strong>Customer-obsessed:</strong> You work backwards from customer needs and stay close to how your software is used.</li> <li><strong>Technically credible:</strong> You ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions and help teams make sound architectural decisions.</li> <li><strong>A multiplier:</strong> You develop other leaders and create an environment where teams can take ownership and succeed.</li> <li><strong>Candid and collaborative:</strong> You give clear feedback, welcome different perspectives and join forces across organisational boundaries.</li> <li><strong>Accountable for outcomes:</strong> You bring focus to complex priorities and follow through on commitments.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits that Benefit You</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Competitive base salary and RSUs.</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Private health insurance & cash plans</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">GymPass subscription</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Life assurance & income protection</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Career growth support and wellness resources</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.</a></em></p> <p><em>Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. title: Project Risk manager - Construction Consultancy
description: 🌟 Position: Risk Manager 📍 Location: Working from home and in the London office 3 days a week 💼 Type: Full-time 📅 Start Date: Immediate We have an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Risk Manager to join our Project Controls team and play an important role in supporting our clients across a range of major construction projects. As a Risk Manager, you will work closely with our Project Controls, Project Management and Commercial teams to support the effective identification, assessment and management of project risks. You will help ensure that risks are understood, appropriately mitigated and effectively communicated to project stakeholders. About us CMR is first and foremost a team of people, passionate about the construction industry and changing the way project controls is provided. We are a progressive and dynamic consultancy offering tailored project controls services across a range of industries. Our Purpose (Why we exist): Inspiring new ways to help shape our construction industry. Our Ambition (What we want to achieve): Re-imagine project controls through a digital lens, being the obvious choice for clients and the place to grow together with intention. 🔹 What’s in it for you? At CMR you will have the opportunity to professionally develop like nowhere you have worked before. If you demonstrate the capability, our merit-based system will enable you to develop quickly. We use our in-house capability matrix to transparently track your progression and highlight development areas. Join our small, dynamic team where every member has the chance to make a significant impact, shaping the future direction of our company and making a real difference. We believe in rewarding our team for their achievements, celebrating our successes but equally helping each other when things are tough. 🔹 You’ll Support the Project Management and Commercial Teams in the effective identification, assessment and management of project risks. Facilitate and support risk workshops, ensuring key risks, opportunities and exposures are identified and appropriately captured. Maintain project risk registers, ensuring risks are clearly defined in terms of causes, events, impacts and appropriate mitigation actions. Work with project teams to assess the likelihood and impact of identified risks and support the development of effective and proportionate responses. Monitor risk mitigation actions and work with stakeholders to ensure agreed actions are progressed and closed out. Support the production of monthly project reports, providing accurate risk information, analysis and insight. Assist with qualitative and quantitative risk analysis to help project teams understand potential cost and schedule exposure. Identify trends, emerging risks and areas of concern, escalating these to senior members of the team where appropriate. Build strong working relationships with project and client stakeholders, helping to promote a positive and proactive risk culture. Contribute to the continuous improvement of CMR's risk management processes, tools and ways of working. Support Senior Risk Managers and Project Controls Leads in delivering high-quality risk management services to our clients. 🔹 We’re looking for: Essential Relevant experience within a project management, project controls or risk management environment. Experience working on major construction or infrastructure projects. A good understanding of risk management methodologies, mitigation processes and techniques. Experience in developing and maintaining project risk registers. Experience facilitating or supporting risk workshops with project stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret project information and identify potential areas of risk. A technically minded individual who can understand technical concepts and communicate them clearly to a wider audience. Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and ask the right questions. A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve project performance and risk management. Desirable Recognised project management or risk qualification such as Association for Project Management (APM) or Institute of Risk Management (IRM). Experience of quantitative risk analysis and/or cost and schedule risk analysis. Experience using risk management or quantitative risk analysis tools such as @Risk, Primavera Risk Analysis, ARM or Safran. Experience working within a project controls environment. 🔹 At CMR We have a strong culture driven by our 9 Core Principles. We look to build a community of people that share our values and ambitions. We’re proud that 96% of our team say CMR is a “Great Place to Work” — a reflection of our supportive culture, focus on people, and drive to do things differently. 👉 Learn more about us here: https://cmr.london/who-we-are/ 📍 Requirements and Location Full right to work in the UK. Working from home and in the Birmingham office 3 days a week. 📦 Salary & Benefits 25 days holiday (plus Bank Holidays) Comprehensive Private Healthcare (including Dentist and Optician) Life Assurance (x4 Salary) Pension: employer contribution of 4% Company and personal performance-based bonus Salary Sacrifice Scheme Long Service Leave Training and professional development Regular social events Perkbox – employee experience platform ➡️ Next Steps To apply for our vacancy, please submit a copy of your CV for consideration . As we receive many applications to our roles, please include a short summary explaining why you want to join CMR and what you think you can bring to the team . We look forward to hearing from you! CMR welcomes and encourages diversity in our workforce. CMR is Disability Confident Committed and an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability or any other protected characteristics. We aim to create a culture where everyone can be themselves and is valued for their strengths and unique perspectives. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Financial Crime Analyst
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst If you’re curious, analytical and enjoy getting into the details, this could be the role for you. Knowledge of CHESAR and other exposure modeling and risk assessment tools. A solid understanding of regulatory toxicology, particularly chemical hazard identification, exposure assessment, and risk characterization. Working knowledge of chemical hazard classification under CLP or GHS, as well as REACH regulatory requirements. A proactive, self-directed approach to work, with the ability to take ownership of technical activities and contribute effectively to a global team. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage with colleagues and stakeholders across different scientific disciplines. title: Engineering Manager
description: TrustFlight builds software that aviation operators around the world rely on to keep flying safe, for an international customer base with an unusually varied set of problems. This role exists to build and sustain a high-performing team of six to eight engineers: coaching each individual, holding a consistent standard of performance, and owning the process, testing, tooling and infrastructure the team depends on. It is a people and systems leadership role rather than a technical leadership one. Product and the technical leads decide what gets built and how; the Engineering Manager owns the conditions that allow them to build it well and quickly. The postholder is one of four Engineering Managers in a Product, Design and Engineering department of around 40 to 50 people, which is growing and maturing quickly. There is considerable scope here to shape how engineering works across it. Key Responsibilities: Raise the performance bar with every hire and every promotion. Treat coaching as a core duty of the role, and upskilling as a standing remit: develop engineers through regular 1:1s, direct feedback, stretch assignments and explicit development plans, and grow technical leads as well as individual contributors. Manage performance fairly and decisively. Set explicit expectations, recognise strong work, raise problems early and allow runway to respond, and address sustained underperformance promptly. Act as the chief unblocker for the team across tooling, infrastructure, testing and process, and own the team's infrastructure-as-code estate. Identify the genuine constraints on throughput, including code review latency, slow or flaky tests, handoffs, approval gates and unreliable environments. Remove them, ensure the team can build, test, deploy, observe and recover quickly and safely, and evidence the improvement in flow metrics. Own testing standards and the consistency of quality across the team, including the definition of “tested”, the criteria that gate a release, and the management of coverage and test flakiness. Quality should not vary according to who wrote the code. Architect cross-team developer tooling and drive consolidation of the technology estate, jointly with peer Engineering Managers and the Director of Engineering. Build the case for moving from a varied stack onto fewer, better-supported technologies. Establish paved roads and automated guardrails that teams adopt on merit, and sequence the change so that it strengthens delivery. Work with the technical leads to maintain an accurate and current picture of technical debt, quality and process constraints. Translate it into risks and opportunities the Product Manager can prioritise, so that the balance between product output and technical excellence is a deliberate decision. Lead the team's adoption of AI-assisted development. Set the standards for where and how AI is used, ensure AI-generated code is understood and accountable to a named engineer, guard against data, licensing and security risk, and maintain an evidence-based view of its effect on the team. Help establish consistent engineering practice across TrustFlight with the other Engineering Managers. No shared approach to levelling, calibration, feedback and hiring yet exists, and building one is part of this role, so that an engineer's experience does not depend on which manager they report to. Required Qualifications & Experience: At least three years' experience as a dedicated people manager of software engineers, including senior engineers and, ideally, technical leads. A software engineering background sufficient to contribute credibly in a design review, challenge an architectural decision on its merits, and distinguish a team that feels fast from one that is fast. The postholder will not act as the team's technical lead and will not be assessed on code they write. Current, practical familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated testing, covering Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent, containerised deployment and a major cloud platform, sufficient to own the estate, set standards and review the work. A track record of raising and holding a quality bar across a team: testing strategy, review standards, and the discipline to keep them consistent as the team and the codebase change. Demonstrable experience of improving how a team works, supported by evidence of the resulting difference. Direct experience of performance management, including at least one case of successfully improving, or fairly exiting, an underperformer. Desirable Skills & Experience Practical experience of agentic development setups, using tools such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, introduced at team or organisation level along with the governance around them. Experience building or operating auditable agent orchestration systems. A strong advantage, though not a requirement. A track record of putting AI workflows into real use, and of helping ship AI features in production applications. An understanding that this field is changing quickly, with the adaptability to keep pace and the credibility to bring a team along on that journey. Experience leading, or contributing materially to, a technology-stack consolidation across multiple teams. Experience raising standards across a heterogeneous or inherited technology estate without mandating uniformity. Experience in a regulated, safety-critical or externally audited software environment, such as aviation, medical, defence or financial services. Valuable, though not a requirement. AI & Digital Competency TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role is expected to actively engage with AI tools and digital ways of working to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation. Tier 3 — AI Builder Develops and integrates AI-powered solutions Builds, fine-tunes, or integrates AI/ML models and pipelines. Establishes evaluation frameworks for AI systems. Ensures responsible AI practices (fairness, transparency, data governance). Contributes to TrustFlight’s AI strategy. Role-Specific AI & Digital Skills: Set and maintain the team's standards for AI-assisted development, covering which tools are approved, where they may and may not be used, and how their output is reviewed. Ensure AI-generated code entering the codebase is understood and accountable to a named engineer, and that review capacity scales with the volume AI produces. Apply AI to strengthen testing and documentation, ensuring that AI-written tests validate the requirement and do not simply confirm the behaviour of the implementation. Establish guardrails against the specific risks of AI-assisted engineering: leakage of customer or regulated data into model context, licensing contamination, and plausible but incorrect code in safety-relevant paths. AI Development & Growth Complete TrustFlight's AI fluency onboarding within the first 30 days. Dedicate time each month to evaluating emerging AI development tooling and agentic workflows, and pilot promising tools in a controlled way. Share findings with the Engineering Manager group and the wider engineering team, including negative results. Contribute to TrustFlight's engineering-wide standards for AI-assisted development, and to the evidence base available to customers and auditors. Competencies & Behaviours: People Leadership — Raises the bar with every hire and promotion; coaches deliberately and develops leaders as well as engineers; creates the conditions for people to do their best work. Fairness and Consistency — Applies the same bar and the same care to everyone; makes reasoning visible; is trusted by engineers and by peers in calibration. Systems Thinking — Treats delivery problems as problems with the system rather than with the people; identifies the constraint before asking for more effort; takes obstacles off other people's desks and measures success by the team's output. Technical Judgement — Sufficient depth to ask the right question, weigh a trade-off, and defer to the technical leads when appropriate. High Standards in a Safety Domain — Holds a consistent quality bar and does not allow defects to pass down the line; recognises that operators' safety cases depend on this software. Working Arrangements: Working Hours: 40 hours per week Work Pattern: Hybrid. London-based, with a minimum of two days per week in the London office and the remainder flexible. Travel Requirements: Occasional travel to other TrustFlight locations and to team or company events. Not a regular requirement of the role. On-Call / Shift Work: Not part of the on-call rota. Accountable for the team’s on-call practice being sustainable and fairly shared. Special Conditions: Right to work in the UK. title: Fospha - Product Manager
description: <p> </p> <h2>About Fospha</h2> <p>Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on. Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha every day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform - and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>We're hiring two Product Managers to own major parts of the Fospha platform. You'll decide what gets built and why, get it shipped, and prove it worked for clients.</p> <p>This is a role for a doer. You'll own a significant product area end to end, set its direction, and run several initiatives at once. A delivery manager and engineering lead run day-to-day delivery alongside you, so your time goes on the decisions that matter: which client problem to solve, what it's worth, what to cut, and whether what shipped actually moved the needle.</p> <p>You'll join an established team, supporting our continued transformation in a post-AI era. We're looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own a product area end to end.</strong> Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. Make the sequencing calls for your area and run several initiatives in parallel.</li> <li><strong>Start every initiative with why.</strong> Before anything is built, be clear on the client problem, the evidence for it, the expected impact for clients, what it's worth commercially, how it fits our pricing and packaging, and how it advances company strategy. Fospha's business strategy hinges on its product strategy, so every initiative should trace back to it. Say no to good ideas that aren't the most important thing.</li> <li><strong>Stay close to clients.</strong> Don't wait to be invited: set up your own client calls as well as joining others', run interviews and prototype sessions, and pair what clients tell you with what the usage data shows. Know what clients see on screen and what they do with it.</li> <li><strong>Decide quickly on imperfect information.</strong> Know when the evidence is strong enough to act, make the call, and change course when the evidence changes, including stopping work that isn't landing.</li> <li><strong>Work AI-first.</strong> Use AI to compress discovery synthesis, analysis, spec writing and stakeholder communication. Build and refine your own agents, workflows and prototypes, and work with engineers on what can be prototyped with AI coding tools. Share what works with other PMs and feed improvements back to Product Ops, so the whole team gets faster.</li> <li><strong>Prove it worked.</strong> Set success thresholds before build starts, check adoption and usage after release, and act on the result. Shipped is not the same as worked.</li> <li><strong>Give people what they need to decide.</strong> Know what information a decision-maker needs at each point, and give them exactly that: a one-line recommendation for an exec, the full detail for an engineer. Present with confidence to senior leaders, internally and at clients.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar.</strong> Give direct, useful feedback, take it well, and hold your own work to a high standard.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring (must-haves)</h2> <ol> <li><strong>3+ years as a Product Manager, or in an adjacent role with experience you can clearly apply to product management.</strong> Either way, you can point to problems you owned end to end: deciding what to do, getting it delivered, and measuring whether it worked against success criteria set upfront.</li> <li><strong>2+ years making decisions from data yourself</strong> - product analytics (funnels, usage, retention) and commercial data - pulling and checking your own numbers rather than waiting for an analyst.</li> <li><strong>A track record of connecting your work to commercial outcomes.</strong> You've sized opportunities in revenue or retention terms, built business cases, and shaped pricing, packaging or monetisation decisions with commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on client experience.</strong> You've run customer discovery, joined sales and account calls, and turned what clients experience into a clear, evidenced problem statement.</li> <li><strong>Confidence in presenting to peers and senior stakeholders.</strong> You're confident making and presenting recommendations to leaders across the business, advocating for data-backed decisions.</li> <li><strong>Deep, everyday use of AI in your work.</strong> You can describe specific workflows, agents or tools you've built or configured, the work they replaced, and how you check their output.</li> </ol> <h2>How you work</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Conscientious.</strong> You close loops, follow through on what you said you'd do, and catch data or quality issues before they reach a client.</li> <li><strong>Relentless about prioritisation.</strong> You can explain why this, why now and what it's worth, and you're comfortable leaving lower-value work undone.</li> <li><strong>Decisive.</strong> You'd rather make a well-reasoned call today than a perfect one next month, and you're open about the assumptions behind it.</li> <li><strong>Analytical.</strong> You break a problem down, work out what would need to be true, and go and find the data to test it.</li> <li><strong>Clear and concise.</strong> You write and present crisply, lead with the recommendation, and cut what the audience doesn't need.</li> <li><strong>Open on feedback.</strong> You give it directly and kindly, ask for it, and act on it.</li> <li><strong>A doer.</strong> You'd rather build a prototype and a short one-pager than write an extensive PRD about one.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Product experience within a complicated B2B data platform business.</li> <li>Product experience within marketing or advertising technology.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits (UK)</h2> <ul> <li>A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%</li> <li>A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!</li> <li>Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps</li> <li>25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)</li> <li>Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one</li> <li>Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal - Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more</li> <li>Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance</li> <li>Paid volunteering days each year</li> <li>Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community</li> <li>Opportunities to travel - including to our India and North America offices</li> </ul> <p> </p><div Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and fan insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role connects fan insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention. Partner with the Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.</li> <li>Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.</li> <li>Source fan insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.</li> <li>Contribute a strong performance POV to creative insight sessions and brainstorms, working closely with the Creative Studio.</li> <li>Share performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Deliver in Six Months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A Markets testing agenda and monthly testing cadence, live within your first 30 days.</li> <li>A documented creative variation framework for Market.</li> <li>A shared testing and learnings rhythm with the OSB Performance Creative team.</li> <li>A steady flow of briefs, tests and written readouts, with winners scaled into the always-on mix.</li> <li>A learnings library and handover documentation so the work continues after the engagement ends.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How This Role Connects Across the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partners closely with the OSB Performance Creative team on shared sport moments, audiences and testing, aligning briefs and calendars, pooling learnings, and adapting proven OSB creative for Market where it fits.</li> <li>Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.</li> <li>Partners with the Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.</li> <li>Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.</li> <li>Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.</li> <li>Partners with the affiliate team on UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice.</li> <li>Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, ideally within a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, sports, gaming or entertainment business.</li> <li>Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.</li> <li>Hands-on experience running creative testing programs at volume.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data and translate it into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to a performance readout.</li> <li>Experience working across matrixed teams and influencing work you don't directly own.</li> <li>Able to ramp quickly and deliver within a fixed-term engagement.</li> <li>Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p> <p>#li-JM3</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process.
