title: Senior Creative Technologist, AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <p>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>The role</strong></h3> <p>This is a hybrid role: a designer who builds, or an engineer who designs. You have the eye to know what good looks like and the code to make it repeatable. You build and run the automated workstreams that Fanatics Casino, and the teams around it, produce brand-safe creative from every day: template and variant generators, image and video generation with our rules built in, copy-to-layout pipelines, Figma plugins.</p> <p>The stack is already here: a shared Figma design system, Figma Motion and Figma Buzz for locked self-serve templates, Figma Weave for generative image and video, Creative Engine for automated static and video assets, and Runway. You turn them into automated templates and workflows that CRM, performance marketing and partners run themselves, with brand, responsible gaming and compliance rules built in so the output is right by default; you own best-in-class video generation, and train the models that keep generated imagery and video looking like us. The tools you make are run by CRM managers, performance marketers and designers across in-app, CRM and paid. You can build, not just brief. Design judgement decides what gets built.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and execute automated workstreams for teams including CRM, performance marketing, partners and design: template and variant generators, copy-to-layout pipelines, Figma plugins and automation scripts that go from brief to approved asset, connecting the existing stack end to end (design system components into Buzz templates, Weave agent workflows for promo imagery, Creative Engine extended from Markets into CRM and in-app).</li> <li>Own best-in-class video generation: set up and run the generative video pipeline across Weave, Runway and Creative Engine for hooks, variants, start frames and localisations, and decide which tool does what where they overlap.</li> <li>Train and maintain LoRAs and custom models on the Casino visual identity, products, characters and partner assets so generated imagery and video stay on-brand without hand-fixing; retrain when the brand or a partner changes.</li> <li>Encode the Casino visual identity, responsible gaming requirements and market-specific compliance rules into every workstream, so a CRM manager or performance marketer can run it and the output is safe by default: disclaimer and RG messaging legible and correctly placed at every size. Creative approves anything new.</li> <li>Target the highest-volume executions first (CRM banners, in-app promo cards, paid variants) and measure the before and after in hours per asset.</li> <li>Own the tools after launch: fix them when the brand, a regulator or a vendor model changes, and retire what stops working.</li> <li>Work with the Lead Motion & 3D Designer on motion templates and render pipelines, and with the Design Lead on how brand rules translate into constraints.</li> <li>Document what you build so the team can use it without you, and train the people who run it.</li> <li>Present the roadmap and results to Design, Marketing and senior leadership in plain terms.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on generative AI in production: image and video generation pipelines across tools like Weave, Runway and ComfyUI, LoRA or fine-tune training for brand consistency, prompt and workflow design. Used through their APIs, not only their interfaces.</li> <li>Judgement about AI output: you can evaluate models on quality, cost, licensing and brand risk, set guardrails, handle failure modes, and tell a marketer plainly what a model can and cannot do.</li> <li>5+ years across design and engineering in any mix, with at least 2 building tools other people used in production. You have shipped design work and you have shipped code; we will ask to see both.</li> <li>Working code: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, Figma plugin development or equivalent, and a track record of shipping something maintainable rather than a prototype.</li> <li>Enough design craft to tell good from bad and to turn a brand guideline into a rule a machine can apply: layout, typography, colour, hierarchy.</li> <li>A portfolio or repo of tools you built, with who used them, what they replaced and what changed as a result.</li> <li>Comfort in a regulated category where some outputs must never ship, and the instinct to design for that.</li> <li>Clear communication with non-technical colleagues, and the patience to train the people who will run what you build.</li> <li>Curiosity about where the tools are going, and a point of view on what we should not automate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>iGaming, sportsbook or another regulated consumer category.</li> <li>Dynamic creative or creative automation platforms (Celtra, Storyteq, Bannerflow, Creatopy) and a view on where they fall short.</li> <li>Motion and 3D pipeline work: After Effects scripting, Cinema 4D or Blender automation, render or FFmpeg tooling.</li> <li>Internal tools with a lightweight front end (React, Streamlit or similar) that non-engineers adopted.</li> <li>Working alongside CRM, lifecycle or performance marketing teams on high-volume, multi-market output.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your first 90 days</strong></h3> <p>You'll learn the stack, the brand rules and the three executions where volume hurts most. You'll ship the first automated workstream against one of them, with CRM running it, and show the hours it saved. You'll have a brand LoRA in use and a clear answer to which of Weave and Runway does what.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit <a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it </em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Public Sector Lead, Central & Local Government
description: <h2>About Scale</h2> <p>Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI. The government's AI Opportunities Action Plan set out to "mainline AI into the veins" of the country, and the focus has now moved to delivery: the Incubator for AI (<a href="http://i.AI">i.AI</a>) is shipping tools like the Humphrey suite into departments, a Sovereign AI Unit and AI Growth Zones are being stood up, and civilian departments are under real pressure to move from pilots to production. Scale can play a foundational role in building the reliable AI applications that shift depends on.</p> <p>We're looking for someone to lead that work in central government. This isn’t about staying in the office and managing a team of sales people, its about building the business from the front. You'd own our commercial relationships across civilian departments, starting where the near-term pipeline is strongest: HMRC, DWP, and NHS.</p> <p>This is a critical role reporting directly to our Head of Public Sector, UK. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into these departments before and knows how they actually make decisions, not just how the org charts look.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK civilian central government</li> <li>Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery</li> <li>Use the relationships you already have across departments like HMRC, DWP, and NHS</li> <li>Work the frameworks, tenders and teaming, and know which route to market is worth the effort and which isn't.</li> <li>Be a credible counterpart to senior civil servants, and turn what they need into work we can deliver</li> <li>Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build</li> <li>Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan with the UK Public Sector Lead</li> </ul> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <ul> <li>You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work to UK civilian central government, either from a vendor or from inside government</li> <li>You’ve rolled up your sleeves and built something from scratch, whether that’s a new vertical, territory or product launch</li> <li>You know at least one major department well (e.g. HMRC, DWP, or NHS) and how it buys</li> <li>You understand public sector procurement: frameworks, tenders, and buying that runs through a lot of stakeholders</li> <li>You've opened doors, run complex pursuits, and owned the result</li> <li>You have relationships with senior people across departments</li> <li>You do your best work when things are ambiguous and moving quickly</li> </ul> <p>People who tend to fit this have spent years leading UK public sector work at companies like Palantir, Google, AWS, Microsoft or Oracle, at consultancies and systems integrators like Accenture, Deloitte, EY, Bain or McKinsey, or in senior commercial or programme roles inside the departments themselves.</p> <h2>Why join</h2> <p>You'd be building this market, not maintaining it. There's no playbook to inherit, which is rather the point. The deals you win, and the way you win them, will shape how Scale works with UK government for years.</p> <h2>About Us</h2> <p>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., Middle Eastern governments, and U.S. government agencies. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Staff Data Center Security Design Manager owns the end-to-end physical security design process for CoreWeave’s data center and critical infrastructure portfolio, from construction drawings and specifications through standards and consultant oversight. Reporting to the Director, Data Center Security Programs and Strategy this position directs physical security design across multiple simultaneous data center projects in the Europe and Middle East regions, ensuring that access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, perimeter fencing, gates, and related systems are designed to a consistent, defensible, and scalable standard.</p> <p>This Staff Security Design Manager is the technical authority on security design, setting and continuously improving CoreWeave’s design standards and Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, directing the work of external design consultants, and leading cross-functional coordination with Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and ICT disciplines. The role requires a seasoned physical security design professional who can resolve complex, multi-team design risks independently, identify value engineering opportunities that protect CAPEX, and mentor other security design managers in a fast-growing, high-performance environment.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Security Design Ownership: </strong>Own the end-to-end security design process including construction drawings, specifications, and standards for physical security systems (access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, perimeter fencing, gates, and more) across multiple simultaneous data center projects in the Americas Region.</li> <li><strong>Standards & Basis of Design: </strong>Drive development and continuous improvement of CoreWeave physical security design standards, Basis of Design (BOD) documents, and template specifications, ensuring they reflect current best practices, emerging technologies, and lessons learned from the field.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Design Leadership: </strong>Participate in cross-functional design reviews and page turns, coordinating with Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and ICT disciplines to deliver integrated, compliant security designs.</li> <li><strong>Risk & Deficiency Resolution: </strong>Identify, assess, and resolve complex design risks and architectural deficiencies proactively, including those that span multiple teams or regions.</li> <li><strong>Emerging Technology Evaluation: </strong>Evaluate emerging technologies, construction methods, and security measures for applicability to CoreWeave infrastructure, and champion adoption where enhanced customer requirements, ROI, and/or scalability justify it.</li> <li><strong>Value Engineering: </strong>Identify risk-appropriate value engineering opportunities to reduce CAPEX spend.</li> <li><strong>Consultant Management: </strong>Serve as the primary technical point of contact for physical security design consultants, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and holding them accountable to CoreWeave standards and SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration & Influence: </strong>Collaborate across CoreWeave Security, DC Design, EHS, and other stakeholders to ensure design outputs align with operational and compliance requirements.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship & Team Development: </strong>Mentor and develop other Physical Security Design Managers, strengthening their technical acumen and design judgment.</li> <li><strong>Construction Reviews: </strong>Conduct construction reviews and design coordination meetings with applicable Security Technical Project Managers responsible for commissioning the security systems..</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of physical security design and/or delivery experience for complex data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects including greenfield owned and leased multi-tenant facility designs.</li> conflicts that span teams or regions.</li> <li>Experience directing and holding external design consultants accountable to scope, standards, and SLAs.</li> <li>Ability to effectively direct Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to produce high-quality, relevant deliverables at scale.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED) principles and their application to data center site and facility security design.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 25%.</li> <li>Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., PSP, CPP, or equivalent physical security design credentials).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! title: Senior MLOps Engineer - Edge
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer for our Hardware Group to build and scale the machine learning infrastructure that powers Focus, our line of smart cameras. You'll own the edge deployment pipelines that transport neural networks from training clusters to tens of thousands of devices globally, and contribute to the platform that compiles trained models into optimised inference engines for devices like the Jetson Orin, building the "nervous system" for the next generation of automated sports capture.</p> <p>As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build scalable Edge infrastructure.</strong> You'll design, develop, and maintain the delivery systems that enable us to deploy models to fleets of devices.</li> <li><strong>Own the model compilation platform.</strong> You'll build and maintain the pipeline that takes trained models and produces optimised, hardware-specific inference engines — managing TensorRT compilation, precision trade-offs (FP16/INT8), calibration, and engine validation to ensure models run reliably and efficiently on target devices.</li> <li><strong>Work with cross-functional teams.</strong> You'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Embedded Engineers, and Product Managers to ensure smooth integration of complex features and capabilities</li> <li><strong>Drive automation and reliability.</strong> You'll implement infrastructure to silently test candidate models on production devices and build telemetry pipelines to monitor drift, thermal impact, and inference latency in the wild.</li> <li><strong>Solve complex physical challenges.</strong> You'll tackle the unique constraints of the edge - building resilient update mechanisms for low-bandwidth environments, optimising for limited storage, and ensuring devices recover gracefully from network failures.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and lead.</strong> You'll share your expertise to establish best practices in Python tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD, guiding the team toward a more robust, automated future.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our offices in London or Barcelona, but we're also open to remote candidates in the UK and Spain.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Production MLOps expertise. </strong>You've played a key role in building and operating pipelines that deploy models to production, with deep experience in CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and Linux systems.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative.</strong> You understand that shipping to hardware is a team sport and can communicate effectively with researchers and low-level embedded engineers to translate constraints into solutions.</li> <li><strong>Systems thinking.</strong> You can design architectures that handle failure gracefully and understand the implications of deploying to 10,000 heterogeneous devices, including how to manage risk via canary releases and safe rollbacks.</li> <li><strong>Bias towards action.</strong> You see your role as solving problems; this means filling gaps and taking initiative as needed to help the team win together.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Edge inference & compilation know-how. </strong>You have hands-on experience compiling and optimising models for embedded hardware - ideally with TensorRT - and understand the practical implications of precision, quantisation, and engine validation at scale.</li> <li><strong>Experience with our Edge AI stack.</strong> Experience with the NVIDIA edge ecosystem (Jetson Orin, DeepStream SDK, TensorRT) is a huge plus.</li> <li><strong>Video Technologies.</strong> Familiarity with video pipelines, GStreamer, or ffmpeg.</li> <li><strong>Fleet management.</strong> Experience with tools like AWS IoT Greengrass, Balena, or custom OTA / fleet management solutions.</li> <li><strong>Sports Passion.</strong> You have an interest in sports technology, video analytics, or performance metrics—but if not, we'll teach you the domain.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy.</strong> We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth.</strong> We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed.</strong> We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing.</strong> Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Manager
description: About EDITED EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. As an Account Manager, you will own senior-level relationships between EDITED and our customers, working with some of the world's leading retailers and brands across fashion, sportswear, and luxury. You will act as a trusted partner to your customers and advocate for their needs within our business. You'll become a true product expert; that means understanding every feature of EDITED and the methodology behind it, as well as being able to introduce and explain it to a wide range of users. You'll be speaking to our clients every day by email, phone and in person, so you’ll need an intrinsic understanding of retail to build strategic relationships and speak knowledgeably about the issues they face. Our expectations for your position: Own the health and growth of your portfolio. Your primary measure of success is retention and expansion. Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and manage the full proposal and contract process through to close. Own the end-to-end renewal process from data analysis and proposal development through contract execution. Identifying and capturing expansion opportunities. Leverage usage data and trends to proactively identify opportunities and get ahead of renewal risks. Develop success plans for each customer that define critical success factors, success metrics, potential risks, and clear recommendations. Drive product adoption across all accounts in your portfolio. Cultivate executive, mid-level, and project relationships across a diverse customer base, turning customers into long-term champions of our brand. Build multi-threaded relationships across each account, with particular focus on senior and executive stakeholders. Identify client risk signals, both through in-person engagement and usage data, and proactively communicate them to your manager. Lead regular progress reviews with customers, including quarterly business reviews and monthly check-ins. This includes clear communication through in-person, zoom/teams, email and PPT presentations. Serve as a credible advocate for our products, with a strong understanding of how retailers and brands operate. Maintain rigorous documentation of account activity, processes, and customer interactions. Clearly articulate product positioning, use cases, and value to a range of stakeholders. Requirements 3+ years working in B2B SaaS Account Management or Head Office Retail Expert technical competence and enthusiasm (understanding of SaaS software or technology and AI competency) Proven success in growing existing accounts and relationships Ideally, proven ability to manage 20 accounts. Perks & Benefits Enhanced parental leave policy 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)Stock options scheme We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. title: Clinic Area Lead, North & Midlands
description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose As the Clinic Area Lead, you will be accountable for bringing Neko Health’s operating model, culture, and member first standards to life across an existing portfolio of clinics in Birmingham and Manchester, as well as future clinics outside of London. This role sits at the intersection of leadership, execution, and local adaptation, ensuring that global ways of working translate into consistently high quality experiences on the ground, while continuing to mature and evolve as we scale. Reporting to the Country Manager, UK, you will own regional performance end to end, from new site readiness through sustained multi-site operations. You will act as the cultural and operational anchor for Neko Health in Birmingham and Manchester, setting expectations, building capability, and reinforcing how clinics lead, operate, and serve members. What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months Continue embedding Neko Health’s operating model across the Birmingham and Manchester clinics, focusing on strong leadership behaviours, cultural norms, and consistent execution rather than net-new process design. Ensure global standards are understood, embraced and brought to life in day-to-day clinic operations. Lead the successful local adoption of existing playbooks and standards, tailoring them thoughtfully to local regulations, team dynamics, and member expectations while preserving the integrity of Neko’s global member experience. Create strong clinic level leadership capability by coaching managers and clinical leads on how to translate standards into practice: setting clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, and role modelling a member first mindset. Establish clear performance rhythms (metrics, reviews, feedback loops) that reinforce behaviours, surface issues early, and continuously improve both team effectiveness and the member experience. Partner closely with the Country Manager, UK and central teams to ensure the global operating model works in practice locally, identifying where light adaptation is required and driving disciplined, high quality implementation at scale. Clinic & Member Experience Ensure each clinic consistently delivers a seamless, premium member experience aligned with Neko Health's service standards and brand promise. Lead regional initiatives to elevate service quality based on member feedback, NPS insights, and frontline observations, iterating playbooks in real time as you learn. Foster a hospitality-driven culture where empathy, professionalism, and precision define every member interaction, and where that culture is embedded through training, not just expectation. Oversee the physical and experiential standards of all clinics, ensuring consistency in ambiance, cleanliness, and overall presentation across a growing portfolio. Medical Quality & Compliance Partner with Clinic Leads and Quality team to build and uphold Neko's clinical quality standards in the UK context, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements from the ground up. Drive continuous improvement in medical delivery and inspection readiness across all sites, establishing audit-ready documentation and escalation protocols. Serve as the bridge between clinic operations and the Medical Excellence team, ensuring best practices are embedded regionally through structured processes rather than informal norms. Operational & Financial Performance Own regional operational KPIs and full P&L accountability, and continue building the financial frameworks alongside the clinics themselves. Oversee workforce planning and staffing models in collaboration with central teams, building hiring profiles, ramp plans, and scheduling logic suited to Birmingham and Manchester’s demand patterns. Contribute to regional business strategy, including network optimisation, market expansion planning, and new clinic launches. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Recruit, onboard, lead, and coach a team of Clinic Leads and Lead Operators across all assigned clinics. Build a strong culture of accountability, communication, and collaboration across distributed teams from day one, establishing the norms and rituals that will define how the Birmingham and Manchester team works. Act as the primary regional liaison between clinic teams and central functions, including Customer Support, Facilities, Workforce Planning, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Demand Planning. Minimum Qualifications Proven experience in a senior operational leadership role (Area Director, Regional Director, District Leader, General Manager or equivalent) within a premium, consumer facing, multi-site environment such as premium healthcare adjacent, wellness, fitness or technology enabled services with physical operations/stores. Demonstrated success implementing and embedding established operating models, standards, and playbooks across multiple locations, driving adoption through leadership, coaching, and accountability rather than documentation alone. Strong track record leading clinic level or site level leaders, with the ability to build capability, reinforce culture, and translate standards into consistent day to day execution. Proven financial and operational acumen, including ownership of regional KPIs, budgets, and P&L performance in a scaling context. Ability to balance strategic perspective with hands on execution, particularly during periods of growth, new site openings, and organisational change. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence operating in a matrixed, fast moving organisation across central and regional teams. Comfort leading through ambiguity and change, with a bias toward action, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution. Ability to be based onsite in Birmingham and Manchester clinics 4 days a week, including regular travel between Manchester and Birmingham as well as any future clinic locations across the UK that are added to your remit. About titles at Neko We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.</p> <h1>The Role: Senior Social Media Manager, Strategy</h1> <p>We are seeking an experienced social strategist who will ideate, create, and deliver comprehensive innovative social strategies that help our clients achieve their business objectives in truly social ways. You'll be keen to understand what the client needs and match that with how we can create and engage, tailored to different social platforms, and always rooted in social audience behaviours.</p> <p>You will be one of the 'go-to' social guardians, helping brands take bold steps to embrace the very best of what social has to offer with our guidance. If you're passionate about social media, have a keen eye for trends & platform updates, and possess exceptional communication skills, we want to hear from you!</p> <p>VML Social is growing and this opportunity is primed for someone that's looking to make great work amongst a team of specialists. We're very fortunate to offer our clients the full range of social expertise, from influencers, content creators, social data, commerce, and of course… strategists.</p> <h1>Key Responsibilities:</h1> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Leadership: </strong>Lead the development and execution of comprehensive social brand, content, and campaign strategies. Respond spontaneously to issues or questions that arise.</li> <li><strong>Channel Understanding: </strong>Demonstrate a truly native and broad understanding of everything social from LinkedIn to TikTok; content and trends, platform and functionality updates, and what the brand's competitors/comparators are doing in social. Share this knowledge proactively with colleagues and clients.</li> <li><strong>Brand Guardianship: </strong>Understand and embody the needs of the brand, matched with social, and how different aspects of the brand need to show up (from personal to business, and from more serious to more fun).</li> </ul> <h1>The ideal candidate will:</h1> <ul> <li>Have a proven track record of developing and implementing successful social strategies for big brands.</li> <li>Be a highly collaborative team player, capable of building strong relationships with clients, internal teams, and external partners.</li> <li>Be a strategic thinker with the ability to 'translate' and communicate complex social data and insights into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Be a compelling storyteller with excellent presentation and communication skills.</li> <li>Be comfortable working in a dynamic environment and managing multiple projects simultaneously.</li> <li>Be passionate about 'what's next' in social, to stay ahead of the curve.</li> <li>Be adept at using data and analytics to measure the effectiveness of social campaigns and optimise performance.</li> <li>Be a proactive and results-oriented individual with a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.</li> </ul> <h1>Qualifications & Experience:</h1> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a social strategy role within an advertising/marketing agency or client team.</li> <li>Strong understanding of social media, with a variety of social platforms, and emerging technologies.</li> <li>Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Proven ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.</li> <li>Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.</li> <li>Experience of working on FMCG clients is highly beneficial although not essential.</li> <li>A degree of some sort will help us understand your background and point of view.</li> </ul> <p>Sound like you? title: Engineering Manager
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line Being an EM at incident.io isn't managing from above. You're close enough to the work to see trouble coming, you're in the room when it's hard, and your team makes better calls because you're there. What that looks like day to day You'll lead a team of engineers who own their work end to end, from the first customer conversation to running it in production. There's no buffer role here. Our engineers talk to customers directly, and so will you. Your job isn't to stand between the team and the outside world, it's to clear the path so they can move. You'll pair closely with product manager, tech lead, and other managers. You stay close enough to every project to know where it stands without asking for a status update. You notice drift early and spot the next bottleneck before the team is faced with it. You know the distinction between micro-managing and being micro-interested. When the team does get stuck, you ask "what would it take?", help them make the trade-off, then back their call with your peers and engineering leadership. We push to deliver as much value as we can, as fast as we can, and work finished beats work started, so you care about getting projects over the line, not just keeping them moving. You hold the bar for everything your team ships, from the product to the comms that go to customers. We want teams so good that engineers elsewhere hear about them and want in. You own the outcomes, including who's on the team: if it needs different people, you go and find them. Customers trust us when things go wrong. They depend on incident.io 's resilience to know when their own systems are in trouble and to invest in making them better. That makes reliability part of everything your team ships, and when something does break on our side, you're in the room keeping things calm and making sure we come out of it stronger. All of our teams are pushing the frontier of what's possible with AI. Investigations, our AI product, runs multi-agent analysis across historical incidents, telemetry systems, multiple datasources, including codebases, to find root cause in minutes. You'll understand these systems well enough to make your team's technical calls better: you challenge assumptions, question complexity nobody needs, and raise the trade-offs people missed. You don't need the best answer in the room, you need to improve the discussion and the outcomes. This isn't a delivery manager role or a people-only one: we think an EM can run a team and still hold a high technical bar. And have fun too (check what one of our EMs built for hiring). The way we work changes often. You'll help shape it, bringing what you've seen work (and not work) elsewhere to improve how we build. Who you are You've managed engineers before, and you came up as one. You might still believe deep down you are still one. You can sit through an architecture discussion, listen for most of it, then ask the one question that makes an engineer rethink their approach. You don't drive every technical decision, but the ones you're part of come out better, and you can explain why they matter to someone who'll never read the code. You measure yourself by how much your people grow, not just what the team ships. You know where each engineer wants to go and find the work that gets them there. And you spot the quiet ones doing great work and make sure others see it too. In our team we call these “ silent killers ”. When the team is on a bad day, your first move is to support them. Nobody does their best work feeling exposed, so you make sure people feel safe and supported, and you know what works best for each person. You work out what drives each person and why they approach things the way they do, and that's what lets you challenge them and have the hard conversations without losing their trust. You care about your engineers and you also push them. Feedback is a gift, as long as it’s well delivered. You give it often and directly, so nobody learns something new about themselves in a review, and you want it back, whether it comes from your manager, a peer or the newest engineer on the team. When the team is stuck, you help them decide rather than deciding for them. Is this the right customer problem? Is the complexity worth it? Does the investment make sense for the business? Sometimes that means pushing back, sometimes that means giving voice to the quite person. In the end, you foster how the team gets to responsible outcomes and you hold the proper accountability. You are biased towards action because you think actions speak louder than words. Obviously you are able to do so whilst being empathetic and managing your peers and stakeholders effectively. You push back on leadership and other managers too. If leadership gets something wrong or our expectations are unclear, you tell us. You've seen what good looks like elsewhere, and you adapt it to our culture rather than dropping it verbatim into our ways of working. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. Compensation: £125K – £160K • Offers Equity • £125K – £160K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary You'll be the deepest technical voice in our sales cycle — the person who can sit with an engineering team, read their stack, and build a working Dust integration before the meeting is over. This role goes well beyond demos: you'll write code, design integration architectures, navigate enterprise security and compliance reviews, and own technically complex POCs with large enterprise and engineering-led accounts. You'll also help shape the SE function itself — building internal tooling and playbooks, mentoring more junior SEs, and feeding direct technical insight into our product roadmap. What you'll do Lead Engineering-Level Technical Evaluations Partner with Account Executives as the primary technical voice for enterprise and engineering-led accounts — the person who earns trust in a room full of engineers and DSIs Run architecture deep-dives, API walkthroughs, and live integration builds with customer engineering teams — not just polished slides Own the technical evaluation end-to-end: scoping, custom environment setup, POC design, success criteria definition, security review support, and close Build — Actually Build Build pragmatic API integrations to customer systems, independently or in collaboration with customer engineering teams, and unblock evaluations without needing to escalate to Dust engineering Build and maintain Dust4Dust internal tooling — agents, workflows, and automations that make the SE team operate at a higher level Navigate Enterprise Complexity Lead security reviews, IT governance discussions, and compliance conversations (GDPR, data sovereignty, SOC2) with CIOs and IT teams — the things that stall deals if no one owns them Articulate Dust’s differentiation in relation to other agentic platforms as well as in contrast to deterministic automation tools (such as Make, Zapier, n8n). Help define the enterprise pilot playbook: repeatable evaluation frameworks, security approval templates, and integration patterns that scale Raise the Bar Across the Team Act as the primary feedback loop to Product and Engineering — translate technical friction from customer conversations into structured, actionable roadmap input Mentor and onboard more junior SEs; help establish the craft bar the function will be measured against Contribute to the SE knowledge base: technical documentation, reusable demo assets, and integration playbooks Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude Strong hands-on coding ability: you write Python, TypeScript, or Bash, call APIs directly, and have shipped real integrations — with concrete projects to show, not side projects Deep understanding of integration architecture: APIs, webhooks, data connectors, authentication patterns — you can design and explain this to an engineering team independently Fluency in LLM/AI architecture: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, data connectors — you can go deep with ML engineers and data teams without needing backup Experience navigating enterprise security reviews: GDPR, data sovereignty, SOC2, IT governance — you understand the questions and know how to answer them Ability to adapt technical depth for any audience — from C-level to DevOps lead — without dumbing down or losing the engineering teams Attitude Builder mindset: you don't wait for a playbook — you write it, then make sure others can use it Low ego, high standards: you give direct that maintain brand relevance and competitive advantage. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Articulate and persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Creating content briefs to feed into our design and editing team, developing copy and making recommendations on assets and content structure and overseeing the management social calendar across multiple regions for a global LinkedIn company page  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Managing client communications including leading content development workstreams, updating WIPs and calendars, internal communication with colleagues  </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>Burson’s Intelligence & Insights capability builds the data infrastructure, pipelines and AI-enabled workflows that power communications measurement and impact reporting at scale. Reporting directly to JT Joseph within the Intelligence & Insights practice and based in London, UK (Hybrid working policy), this role is central to leading the technical development of Fount, Burson’s flagship communications intelligence platform.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for translating product vision and technical specifications into robust, scalable data engineering and business intelligence solutions. Working closely with product leadership, you will contribute technical insights and architectural recommendations that help shape the platform's future evolution. You will operate within a structured Agile team managed in Jira, where product vision, priorities and roadmaps are set by Product Owners, while your core focus is executing this vision to the highest engineering standards.</p> <p>You will serve as the lead engineer responsible for building, maintaining and enhancing Fount, Burson’s custom data pipeline and database layer for communications reporting. Fount enables analysts to configure client monitoring subscriptions, Boolean searches, data ingestion and AI enrichment through an analyst-facing configuration layer. Under the direction of product leadership, you will execute technical deliverables that make the platform more reliable, scalable and seamless for non-technical users to configure and operate.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role with technical leadership and mentoring responsibility, rather than a formal people-management position. You will directly mentor a junior engineer while providing technical peer support and alignment across the wider engineering team. The position combines strategic engineering with hands-on delivery across major pillars:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Leadership & Architecture</strong> (e.g., pipeline design, engineering standards, technical reviews, technical debt refactoring, mentoring)</li> <li><strong>Fount Platform & Data Engineering</strong> (e.g., ETL/ELT pipelines, Python services, SQL layers, API integrations, cloud infrastructure, cost & performance optimization)</li> <li><strong>Analyst Enablement & AI Integrations</strong> (e.g., NocoDB configuration, Boolean ingestion, LLM enrichment frameworks, MCP & provider-hosted integrations)</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the technical design, architectural standards, and delivery of business-critical data pipelines, services, and platform components across media monitoring and communications data sources.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Owners in an Agile Jira environment to assess technical feasibility, evaluate trade-offs, and translate product requirements into maintainable, scalable technical solutions.</li> <li>Build and maintain production-ready Python services, SQL transformation layers, star-schema data models, and API integrations across relational databases and cloud storage (Azure Data Lake).</li> <li>Optimise pipeline performance, system reliability, compute efficiency, and AI token costs, while establishing robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-response practices.</li> <li>Enhance Fount’s analyst-facing configuration layer (Boolean searches, API ingestion rules, NocoDB workflows) to streamline analyst setup and reduce routine engineering intervention.</li> <li>Operationalise AI-enabled enrichment frameworks (classification, summarisation, sentiment, topic detection, LLMs, MCP-enabled integrations) with strict quality assurance, governance, and cost controls.</li> <li>Deliver custom data engineering solutions for specialized client requirements, integrating internal, API-driven, and third-party research datasets into scalable reporting workflows.</li> <li>Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, architectural guidance, and knowledge-sharing, while systematically refactoring technical debt and maintaining operational runbooks.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing, building, and operating production data platforms, star-schema data models, and complex ELT/ETL pipelines.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, including clean object-oriented design, Pandas, query optimization, and REST API integrations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, ADLS), Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.</li> <li>Proven track record in system reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, logging/monitoring, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability mentoring junior engineers and elevating team capabilities through code reviews, technical standards, and documentation.</li> <li>Agile execution expertise using Jira, partnering closely with Product Owners to evaluate technical trade-offs and manage competing roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern AI & integration frameworks, including LLM enrichment workflows, semi-structured formats (e.g., Parquet), NoSQL, and provider-hosted or MCP-enabled integrations.</li> <li>Exposure to complementary technologies, such as low-code UI tools (NocoDB/Airtable), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Terragrunt), Power BI/DAX, or communications measurement data.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>#LI-SF2</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>More about the role</strong><br>We are a diverse team of 45+ healthcare communications specialists who thrive on curiosity, the thrill of a challenge, good old-fashioned fun and working in partnership with clients to improve the health of the world, one brilliant idea at a time.</p> <p>We deliver global, EMEA and UK integrated marketing communications solutions for many of the world’s leading healthcare companies.</p> <p>Our breadth of work is limitless, as we challenge ourselves to innovate in all that we do and really make a difference. If it’s led by solid-insight or data, nothing is out of reach; from traditional media campaigns, data communications and brand launches, to multi-channel digital and social media programmes, to influencer campaigns and disease awareness initiatives, to patient apps or patient advocacy partnerships, to multi-award-winning corporate re-positioning videos and crisis management, the list is endless.</p> <p>We believe that working here is a chance to change lives, including your own. We’re a super supportive team with a warm, friendly and social culture. Through our solid PDP process and ongoing training and support, we pride ourselves on nurturing our people to be their very best.  </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the strategic development and delivery of integrated, insight-led communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.</li> <li>Act as a day-to-day lead across projects, ensuring high-quality delivery, alignment with client goals, and consistent performance against KPIs.</li> <li>Translate complex healthcare data (e.g. clinical trials, real-world evidence, HES data) into compelling narratives that support client messaging and engagement.</li> <li>Lead and inspire account teams, providing mentorship, fostering collaboration, and ensuring continued professional growth.</li> <li>Partner with senior leadership to shape strategic proposals and pitch documents, contributing to business development and organic account growth.</li> <li>Cultivate strong, trusted client relationships by demonstrating sector expertise, strategic counsel, and proactive problem-solving.</li> <li>Collaborate across Burson's network, including creative, digital, and strategy teams, to deliver bold, integrated campaigns that challenge the status quo.</li> <li>Contribute to the broader agency culture by actively participating in forums, operational initiatives, and thought leadership efforts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success      </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience delivering UK, EMEA, and global communications programmes for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.</li> <li>Strong track record in building and maintaining trusted client relationships, with hands-on leadership of integrated campaigns.</li> <li>Skilled in data and brand communications, including digital, social media, disease awareness, and advocacy initiatives.</li> <li>Confident in managing project financials, forecasting, and reporting, with experience contributing to successful new business pitches.</li> <li>Demonstrated people management skills, including team leadership and direct line management.</li> <li>Known for being collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering high-quality, insight-led work.</li> <li>Brings a growth mindset with enthusiasm for learning, development, and tackling challenges positively.</li> <li>Values an inclusive, open-minded, and supportive team culture where individuality is embraced.</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-SF1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Process Excellence Manager
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Operational Excellence Team The Systems & Insights team at Wayve is integral to designing and scaling the operational systems powering our global Fleet Operations. As we transform from an R&D-focused operation to a world-class, delivery-grade AV test organisation, our team leads critical process improvement initiatives, shaping how our operations evolve and perform across all international sites. 🧠 Your day-to-day Lead end-to-end analysis and documentation of Fleet Operations workflows, using BPMN or equivalent notation to define AS-IS and TO-BE processes. Drive structured improvement projects using Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Kaizen, etc.) to improve efficiency, quality, and throughput. Collaborate with regional and cross-functional teams to standardise operations, eliminate waste, and improve process stability and repeatability. Define and implement operational frameworks, including SLAs, SOPs, escalation procedures, and RACI matrices. Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and other visual management tools using data analytics and SQL to monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and quantify improvements. Work with software, data, and infrastructure teams to scope and support the automation of repetitive or high-volume tasks. Serve as a strategic partner to Operations leadership, providing structured problem-solving for key growth and scalability challenges. Champion continuous improvement and coach teams on process design and operational excellence best practices. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Process mapping, analysis, and documentation across Fleet Operations (UK and international). Leading cross-functional Lean Six Sigma initiatives to reduce waste and optimise processes. Standardising workflows and implementing operational frameworks across global sites. Designing and implementing KPIs, dashboards, and visual tracking tools for process performance. Identifying and enabling automation opportunities in collaboration with engineering and data teams. Advising on scaling operations and supporting change enablement across the organisation. 🙌 You should apply if You have 5+ years’ experience in process improvement, operations design, or operational excellence roles in high-complexity environments such as tech, logistics, robotics, manufacturing, or mobility. You hold Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification, have equivalent experience running high-impact continuous improvement initiatives, or are certified in continuous improvement methodologies. You have deep experience with workflow mapping, process documentation (BPMN), and standardisation. You have strong facilitation skills: able to lead workshops and interviews with technical and frontline stakeholders. You are skilled in SQL and data analysis; able to pull data and build or interpret dashboards and trackers. You have experience with AI-driven business process automation. You have a growth mindset, curiosity, and enthusiasm for exploring emerging technologies and products. You are familiar with incident management, readiness reviews, and risk/control frameworks. You have a proven ability to influence across teams and functions, including remote or global stakeholders. You have strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including documentation, SOPs, and presentations. You have strong documentation and technical writing skills. You have experience implementing task management tools and working with internal tools on operational product development. You have experience supporting the scaling of global, distributed teams. You can travel internationally up to 10% of the time to support process design and change adaptation across all operational sites. Desirable: Experience in autonomous systems, robotics or field operations. Exposure to process mining tools (e.g. Celonis, UiPath Process Mining). Team management or mentoring experience. Familiarity with operational learning and development practices and quality improvement frameworks. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. Run ablation studies and investigate failures in visual quality, temporal consistency, motion, and action conditioning. Optimise inference efficiency, manage GPU resources, and ensure data quality throughout the pipeline. title: Senior Software Engineer - Credit
description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role LemFi's Credit tribe is early and moving fast. We're building the infrastructure that will power lending products for millions of people who've historically been locked out of fair credit - immigrants, diaspora communities, and the financially underserved across our 21 operating markets. This is a ground-floor opportunity: the tribe is being built right now, and the systems you design today will be the foundation everything else sits on. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Credit tribe and own core backend services end-to-end. You'll be working primarily in Go, with some existing Java services in the mix - switching between them is not the blocker, deep engineering craft and an instinct for how credit products behave is. We move fast and we don't micromanage, which means you'll need to bring the domain awareness to make the right call before anyone has to tell you. What you'll build and own Design, build and operate high-reliability backend services that power LemFi's credit products, from loan origination and underwriting through to repayment and collections. Make the right architectural calls independently - data residency, service boundaries, state-machine design for loan lifecycles - without needing to be told what a credit-safe system looks like. Own your services in production: instrument them, monitor them, debug them, and hold the bar on reliability and correctness. Work closely with product and compliance to translate credit-domain requirements into clean, testable, maintainable code. Use AI coding tools actively to accelerate delivery and improve test coverage, while taking full ownership of the correctness of every line that ships. Contribute to growing the tribe - as one of the earliest engineers you'll help set the engineering culture, review others' work, and raise the bar on how we build. Your experience Strong backend engineering in Go; Java experience is a plus given our existing services, but Go is the primary language. Meaningful fintech experience - you understand how financial systems behave under load, under regulation, and under audit. Exposure to credit products (lending, underwriting, repayment, collections) at any level - even adjacent - so you arrive with the right instincts, not just a willingness to learn them. Solid grasp of distributed systems design: event-driven architecture, service boundaries, data consistency, and failure modes. You care about correctness and data integrity as much as velocity - you've worked in environments where getting it wrong has real consequences for real people. Comfortable operating with autonomy in an environment where the spec is never fully finished and the team is still being built. Nice to have Direct experience building credit decisioning, risk scoring, or loan management systems. Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up where you helped establish engineering foundations from scratch. Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints specific to consumer credit (e.g. FCA, data protection requirements for credit data). Why join LemFi? Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down. Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Marketing, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Legal, and Operations to deliver measurable customer and commercial value. </p> <p>This role requires a commercially minded, data-savvy operator who can frame ambiguous problems, work hands-on with data, influence strategic choices, and translate insight into execution with pace and
